title: Common Edges
author: Common Edges
description: As a first-generation Latina, I’ve always lived between two worlds, and I’m still figuring out how to keep growing in both. Common Edges is where I stay curious as life changes: how upbringing, culture, and family expectations keep shaping work, relationships, and identity, plus whatever I’m wrestling with this week and everything in between. What was passed down, what I’m questioning, and what still fits. Short solo episodes, and conversations with my co-host Mirna when she can make it. No experts or prescriptions, just honest reflection from someone still working it out.

title: Calm Science For Sleep
author: Calm Science For Sleep
description: Welcome to Calm Science For Sleep 🌙 Space & science facts to fall asleep to — where curiosity slows down, and the universe becomes a place to rest. Here you'll find peaceful, sleep-friendly journeys through space, astronomy, physics, Earth, and the quiet wonders of science — real facts told with calm narration, beautiful visuals, and a slow, gentle pace made for deep relaxation and sleep. Whether you're falling asleep, unwinding after a long day, studying, or simply enjoying thoughtful documentaries, every video helps your mind slow down while your curiosity stays awake.

title: Sleep with Science
author: Sleep with Science
description: This channel is for those who love science but also need quiet. For people who fall asleep to documentaries, who relax to the sound of space, nature, and thoughtful explanations. If your mind feels too busy at night, you’re not alone. Here, we explore the universe, Earth, the ocean, the human mind, animals, evolution, and the quiet mysteries of existence — all told slowly, gently, and without overstimulation. Every video includes soft 432Hz background music to help you unwind and drift into sleep.

A few minutes with God, together. By @crosslifeco

author: Rubenz Musik
description: Kombat Sessions is the mix show from Fort Worth DJ Ruben Z (formerly Re5a, founder of G&D Records). Bass house, dubstep, drum & bass and house — recorded from the Kombat Sessions crates, built for the dancefloor and the drive. New mixes all year, including the December 2026 Drum & Bass session.

title: Unbound
author: J. B. L. Barker
description:
UNBOUND is an original cinematic survival horror audio series from Nightmark Media.
A forest that watches back. A journey into the dark. Something waiting just beyond sight.
Soldiers and civilians are drawn into an escalating fight for survival against something they do not yet understand. At the centre of the story is Callum Vance, an elite former sniper known as Grimm — a man carrying old injuries, fractured loyalties and a past that refuses to stay buried.
As the story unfolds, the line between hunter and hunted begins to disappear.
Written by J. B. L. Barker.
Narrated by Mike Davison.
Produced by Nightmark Media.
New chapters released weekly.

title: Pocket Edition: A Watch Podcast
author: Daniel Sonnier
description:
Pocket Edition is a watch podcast about the people behind the dial.


Most good watches start small. Some begin as a sketch on a napkin. Others survive a prototype that didn’t work or a Kickstarter that barely funded. Your host Daniel, talks with the founders of independent watch brands about how they got from that first idea to a watch on someone’s wrist.


The show starts with microbrands and will grow to include watchmakers, designers and collectors. Every so often, Daniel records a solo episode on brands that aren’t what they claim to be.


Pocket Edition is the companion podcast to the Daniel’s Pocket microbrand reviews on YouTube.

title: Science To Sleep
author: Science To Sleep
description: Welcome to Science to Sleep – where discovery meets dreams. This channel is your nightly escape into the world of science, offering the latest updates, in-depth analysis, and calming commentary on everything from atoms to galaxies. We cover major scientific events, breakthroughs, and timeless profiles of the thinkers and theories that shape our universe — all delivered in a relaxed, sleep-friendly tone designed to help you unwind. Whether it's breaking news in space exploration, the quiet history behind a Nobel Prize, or the soft unraveling of a forgotten theory, Science to Sleep brings you knowledge at the speed of rest.

title: Live from the Southside with April Monterrosa
author: April Monterrosa
description: Join award-winning author and publisher April Monterrosa for engaging conversations with entrepreneurs, entertainers, community leaders, and inspiring personalities. Live From The Southside with April Monterrosa brings you the people, stories, and experiences worth sharing from San Antonio, across Texas, and beyond.

title: Audiobook 101
author: Audiobook 101
description: Welcome to Audiobook 101, your go-to destination for concise and insightful summaries of popular audiobooks. Whether you're a busy professional looking to expand your knowledge on the go or a curious learner exploring new topics, our channel is here to provide you with bite-sized summaries that capture the essence of each audiobook. Join us on a journey of learning, discovery, and inspiration as we delve into the world of literature through the power of audio.

title: History Well Told
author: Pri-media
description: History Well Told is an aural palimpsest — a podcast that scrapes back the varnish of time and reads the faint, electric undertext. We’re time-sleuths and raconteurs: excavating forgotten protagonists, unspooling the tectonic moments that rewired civilization, and stepping into the liminal theatre where myth, memory, and politics collide. Expect immersive audio documentaries — textured soundscapes, rigorous scholarship, and human-centered narratives — each episode an act of analepsis that makes the past feel immediate, strange, and insistently alive.

title: Neville Lectures
author: Neville Lectures
description:
Neville’s Secret is a channel dedicated to revealing the timeless teachings of Neville Goddard and the hidden laws of manifestation, imagination, and consciousness.
Here, you will learn that you are not waiting for life to change — you are the power that changes it.
Every video is designed to help you awaken to your true creative nature and consciously shape your reality from within.
On this channel, you’ll discover:
The real meaning of “Feeling is the Secret”
How to use imagination to manifest wealth, love, success, and peace
Why your state of consciousness determines everything
Hidden Neville Goddard lectures explained in simple, practical ways
Techniques to manifest faster without force, effort, or struggle
This is not motivation.
This is transformation.

Unofficial fan audio feed — not affiliated with or endorsed by the original creator. All content belongs to its respective owner.

title: At the End of the Therapy Hour
author: Dr Mary Bricker and Dr Barbara Gilbert
description:
Two Clinical Psychologists are nearing their retirement and discuss what they have learned from their 40+ years of providing psychotherapy in a number of settings to a very diverse group of clients/patients. They delve into the amazing resilience of the human psyche, their best understanding of how people come to struggle and how they get better, the processes behind the therapist's interventions, the profound and the profane, and all the wisdom that comes from engaging with thousands of lives in this way.  

The weekly podcast is free to listen, but for those who want to support the podcast, subscriptions are available.  With the "Supporter subscription", we offer early access, and the opportunity to ask questions that we will be sure to address in future episodes! With the "Psychotherapist subscription", we offer early access, the opportunity to ask questions we will address in future episodes and also access to a monthly bonus episode in which we offer training in difficult issues, specific skills or conceptualization, sometimes with role plays.  Check the show notes for details.

title: To Be Honest,
author: Kai
description:
Hi, I'm Kaia, or Kai, and welcome to To Be Honest, a podcast about life, growing up, friendships, opinions, and all the unexpected plot twists that come with being a teen.
Here, we'll talk about the things we're all thinking but don't always say out loud. Sometimes it'll be serious, sometimes chaotic, and sometimes I'll just have something to say. 😭
I'm not here because I have life figured out. I'm here because I'm living it, learning as I go, questioning everything, and sharing my thoughts along the way.
So hi and welcome! :)

title: Arun Mago
author: Arun Mago
description: Arun Mago is an Indian-origin Certified Public Accountant (CPA) and Chartered Accountant (CA) based in Texas, USA. Arun Mago completed his graduation from Delhi University in 1999 and obtained his Chartered Accountancy qualification from ICAI, New Delhi, in 2001–02. He began his professional career with accounting firms and in the corporate sector before moving to the United States in 2003, where he pursued further studies and obtained his CPA qualification.Since 2010, Arun Mago has been running his own accounting and tax practice in Texas. His professional services include tax preparation, tax planning, accounting, bookkeeping and financial consulting. According to his published book biography, he has also participated in public seminars and motivational speaking, with an interest in motivating people and helping them achieve their potential.

title: Dark Heart of Europe: Central European True Crime
author: Ivan Harmat
description: The true crime stories Central Europe never told the world. From communist-era serial killers to modern murders that gripped Czechia, Slovakia and other neighboring countries, each episode digs into the crime, the investigation, and the verdict, without forgetting the victims. Researched by a native Slovak and narrated by AI voices.

author: Andy Sovis and Megan Welke
description:
Our goal is simple: make mental health conversations approachable, useful, relatable—and sometimes a little funny.
Between Sessions is for educational and informational purposes only. Our conversations are not therapy, a substitute for therapy, or individualized clinical advice. Everyone’s circumstances are different. If you’re looking for support tailored to your unique needs, we encourage you to reach out to Forward Therapy & Consulting or another qualified mental health professional. We’re glad you’re here, and we hope these conversations help you feel a little more understood.

title: Relaxing Science for Sleep

title: Building The Ark
author: Lucas Mijares
description:
Building The Ark is the story of transforming a once empty school campus in Penn Valley, CA into a thriving community center where people can gather, play, learn, and belong. 
Join hosts Lucas Mijares and K2 Nelson as they take you behind the scenes of The Ark — sharing the vision, renovations, victories, challenges, and incredible people bringing it all to life!

thearkpv.com

title: Embers and Era: History Stories for Sleep
author: Embers And Era
description:
Slow, soft-spoken history stories based on real facts, to help you fall asleep.
Each long episode takes you into ordinary life in a past time: a night in a Roman camp, the glow of a hearth, the hush after dark. Just a calm voice and a gentle pace. Perfect for winding down or insomnia nights.
Researched from historical and archaeological sources. Where evidence is missing we say so, and small details may be imagined for atmosphere. Made for rest, not as a scholarly reference. Narrated with ai calm cozy and warm voice.
Follow for a new story at bedtime. Let the fire burn low, Amber D

title: Parenting by John Ewer
author: Jhonatan Ewer
description:
But one day, they may understand the sacrifices, patience, and love behind your decisions.
Until then, stay strong, protect your coffee, hide your favorite snacks, and remember that parenting is not about raising perfect children.
It is about raising good human beings while trying to survive the chaos along the way.
And if all else fails, remember the golden rule of parenting: never challenge a toddler to a battle of stubbornness. They have more experience, unlimited energy, and absolutely nothing to lose.

description:
VYX is a podcast created by Priscilla Solorio Zepeda, founder and creative director of XZYRA Studio.
It’s a space for the conversations that usually remain unspoken—creativity, business, healing, identity, independence, ambition, and the reality of building a life of your own.
From navigating trauma and CPTSD to graduating from college and building a creative business at twenty, Priscilla shares her experiences while they’re still unfolding. Not as a perfectly finished success story, but as an honest look at becoming.
The ideas. The setbacks. The growth. The uncomfortable conversations. And everything that happens between who you were and who you’re becoming.
This is VYX.

title: Morning Prayer Podcast 🕊️
author: Franciana Robana
description:
Guided Morning Prayers podcast is for anyone looking for a daily dose of spiritual inspiration 🙏🕊️
Every day at 5am EST, we bring you uplifting sermons and prayers that breathe life into your Christian faith. This isn't just a podcast; it's a journey through faith, a personal guide helping you connect with the divine each morning.
Our episodes are curated with care, providing a mix of prayers and sermons that resonate with the challenges and triumphs of modern life. We draw from Christian tradition and scripture, offering wisdom that's applicable to your day-to-day experiences. The goal? To start your day with spiritual enlightenment, to help you navigate life with grace and fortitude.
We are more than a religious program; we are a community of likeminded believers. With each sunrise, we unite in prayer, creating a spiritual network that transcends boundaries. We invite you to be part of this community, to strengthen your faith and find solace in shared prayer.
In the hustle of life, it's easy to forget the healing power of prayer and wisdom of sermons. We're here to help you reclaim these moments, to start each day with a note of spiritual mindfulness. Let our podcast be your reminder that amidst life's noise, prayer can be a source of comfort and hope.

title: Still Can't Explain
author: Still Can't Explain
description: Still Can't Explain is a podcast of first-person stories. Each episode, real people tell a strange experience that happened to them, in their own words: lights in the sky, ghosts, time slips, missing time, glitches in the matrix. There's no host and no debunking. We don't claim these stories are proven. We share them as each teller's own experience, and many have never been told publicly before. Got a story of your own? title: We Were Broken Until
author: Sharlett L Charles
description:
We Were Broken Until is a raw and redemptive podcast where childhood trauma meets truth-telling, healing, and hope.
Hosted by Sharlett L Charles, a survivor of generational pain, sexual abuse, and emotional abandonment, this series dives into the deepest wounds of our youth—and how they shape our adult lives.
Each episode explores a moment in childhood that left a scar… and the journey of what happened next.

When he falls in love with Julia, he begins to rebel against the system, risking his life.Through this novel, Orwell explores important themes such as the loss of freedom, the abuse of power, censorship and the manipulation of truth. 1984 is a powerful warning about the dangers of dictatorship and a society where individuals have no right to think freely. Salt & Stories begins here.
We begin with food, following it into memory and writing. For sometimes, writing is not about creating a story, but finding our way back to ones there all along.
A bowl of soup, emptied without a thought. A dinner we were certain we’d forget. Perhaps that is enough to write a life.

Through personal stories, thoughtful questions, and practical steps, you’ll explore how to release expectations that no longer fit, speak up for your needs, and rebuild trust in yourself. Faith is woven naturally into conversations that make room for uncertainty, reflection, and growth.

Whether you’re navigating an ending, choosing a different direction, or asking, “What do I want now?” this podcast offers space to reconnect with yourself and take your next step with greater clarity.

Your needs matter. Your voice matters. There is more of your story to live.

title: Up Your Average

description: Up Your Average is the “no nonsense” podcast made for interesting people who think differently. Learn to navigate your life with unconventional wisdom by tuning in to Keith Tyner and Doug Shrieve every week.

author: Producer AZ
description: After Hours Corner is a comedy interview show where Producer AZ talks with independent artists and local business owners about their best stories. You'll get entertainment, laughs, and the kind of community that keeps you going.

title: Geo Metrics: the incredible stories maps don't tell you
author: Geo Metrics
description: Welcome to GeoMetriics—your ultimate destination for mind-bending geography, bizarre history, and uncovering the strangest secrets hidden right beneath our feet. We dive deep into lesser-known landscapes, forgotten anomalies, and the fascinating stories maps don't tell you. If you love exploring Earth's greatest mysteries, hit subscribe and join us every week as we look beyond the surface!

title: Scarface Minute
author: Joe Krueger
description:
Welcome to Scarface by the Minute, the podcast that breaks down Brian De Palma's 1983 crime epic one minute at a time.
Each episode zooms in on a single minute of the film: what's on screen, what happened behind the camera, and the real history that inspired it. From the 1980 Mariel boatlift to the cocaine-fueled Miami of the early 80s, we dig into the true stories behind Tony Montana's rise, along with the cast, the crew, and the craft that made Scarface a cultural icon.
Along the way, you'll hear recurring segments like Minute Myths, where we separate fact from legend; the Temper Tracker and Ruthlessness Meter, where we chart Tony's slow boil; a lightning round of facts and figures; and our official rating of every minute on the cocaine mountain scale.
Whether you've seen Scarface fifty times or you're watching it for the first time, pull up a chair. We've got about 170 minutes to get through.

title: Habit 12: Review & Preview
author: Kat Lee
description: A one month daily podcast for Hello Mornings Members to build a Review & Preview Habit

title: Us From My View
author: Gold Havilah Victoria
description:
Welcome to our little corner of the world, where love, partnership, ambition, and everyday life meet.
Link Break: (Tiktok, YouTube(video Podcast, IG)
tiktok.com/@jefferyokeandgoldhavilah
youtube.com/@JefferyokeandGoldhavilah

No scripts, no elaborate introductions. Just honest conversations alone, with my Partner; personal reflections, and life as it unfolds.

title: Geek & Grimm
author: Seth Poiley
description:
Geek by day. Grimm by night.
Geek and Grimm explores the strange crossroads where pop culture meets folklore. Superheroes, sci fi, fantasy worlds, cursed arcade games, haunted toys, urban legends, and forgotten mysteries all share the same shelf here.
Each episode uncovers an artifact. Sometimes it comes from fandom. Sometimes from the shadows of history. Always from the place where imagination and myth overlap.
Short episodes. Curious stories. A little eerie, a little nerdy.
Because the line between fiction and folklore has always been thinner than it looks.

title: Church Unlimited Hazyview
author: Church Unlimited Hazyview
description: Weekly sermons from Church Unlimited Hazyview in Mpumalanga, South Africa. Biblical teaching centred on Jesus Christ, helping us grow in faith, follow Him in everyday life, and live as part of His Church. Listen to messages from our Sunday gatherings, local elders and guest speakers.

title: The Encounter with Christ
author: Dawn Nessen
description: This podcast is about trauma experience and how Jesus helps those who experience trauma by inviting Jesus into our hearts to heal with trust.

title: D&N Tree Care Inc
author: D&N Tree Care Inc
description: D&N Tree Care Inc provides tree removal, trimming, pruning, stump grinding, and emergency tree service in Ontario, CA. Call (909) 729-4667. Website: https://dntreecareinc.com

title: Cavins' Legacy Podcast
author: Phillip Cavins
description:
The Cavins Legacy Podcast, hosted by Phillip and Abram Cavins, brings family together to share stories, laughter, memories, and life experiences. Open to all Cavins family members and relatives, the podcast welcomes guests and new hosts from every generation. Participation is voluntary, and anyone featured can request edits or removal of an episode. Our goal is to preserve the voices, personalities, and stories of our family for generations to come.
Our family. Our stories. Our legacy.

title: Passport to Slumber
author: Renee Fleming
description:
Travel the world while you drift away.  🌙
Get cozy, close your eyes, and let the world unfold. Passport to Slumber is a guided sleep travel podcast that takes you on peaceful journeys to some of the world's most beautiful and fascinating destinations—all from the comfort of your bed. 
Each episode blends immersive storytelling, gentle guided meditation, and soothing soundscapes to help you unwind, quiet your mind, and ease into a restful night's sleep. Along the way, discover the quiet beauty of each destination through rich sensory details, local traditions, and moments of gentle reflection. 
Created for curious minds and weary souls, these bedtime journeys invite you to slow down, savor the little things, and experience the wonder of the world without ever packing a suitcase. 
Whether you're looking for sleep stories for adults, guided relaxation, or simply a peaceful escape at the end of a long day, your next journey begins here. 
Your destination is beautiful. Your only itinerary is rest.

title: American Corridors
author: Mystery Box
description:
Every legend starts as a story someone swore was true. In American Corridors, a lone traveler drives the Mother Road from end to end and at every stop, in a roadside diner, a flickering motel or a gas station at the edge of the desert, a stranger tells a tale rooted in the place they call home. Some are legends. Some are confessions. Some might not be stories at all.

Starring Tony Hale, Cynthy Wu, Eric Phillips, Mac Steel Foster, Elizabeth Golden, Darrell Dennis, Matt Bidel, and Cara Jade Myers.

A scripted audio drama anthology from Mystery Box. Listen with the lights low.

title: Notes From The Waiting Room
author: Samia Aziz
description: The podcast where we open up honest conversations about our health and everything that comes with it. I’m Samia, and together we’ll explore the questions we don’t always ask, the hopes we carry, and all the ways we find ourselves waiting.

title: Values to Action Podcast
author: Annie Stephanos/Highroads Coaching
description: The Values to Action Podcast follows one fictional woman through one decision—the kind that doesn’t have an obvious right answer. In 15 minutes, you’ll step into her story, discover what matters most to her, face the reality of her situation, and consider the trade-offs each choice requires. Annie Stephanos, founder of Highroads Coaching and creator of the Highroads Decision Process, guides the story with thoughtful questions—not advice about what the character should do. By the end, she makes a decision she can stand behind. And somewhere in her story, you may recognize something in your own.

title: SHARP with Cody Johns

Every Friday, The Cruise Boys®, powered by KVI Travel, breaks down the week’s biggest cruise headlines and what they mean for your booking. That includes new ships, itinerary changes, price and policy updates, and the deals worth your time. We cover Virgin Voyages, Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Carnival and every major line, plus river cruising, LGBTQ+ sailings and flying tips for cruisers. Ready to book? Request Pricing at TheCruiseBoys.com.

author: Kaelynn Priest
description:
For LDS Business owners who are craving conversations and stories about building businesses and seeking God through the uncertainties of entrepreneurship.
We'll examine all of the "good fruits" that can come from running a business beyond monetary blessings, like personal growth, meaningful relationships, and a deeper relationship with the Savior.

title: USA Peptide Depot
author: Chaudhry pod
description:
USA Peptide Depot explores the analytical science behind research peptides and laboratory reference materials. The podcast focuses on HPLC testing, peptide characterization, certificate-of-analysis interpretation, batch traceability, and the scientific limits of common quality measurements.

Episodes are educational and do not provide medical advice, treatment guidance, or instructions for human or veterinary use. This podcast includes AI-generated narration.

title: SmallBusinessTaxes.com
author: SmallBusinessTaxes.com
description: Small business taxes without the jargon. Picking the right entity and knowing when an S-corp election pays off, setting a reasonable owner salary, the deductions owners miss and the ones that draw attention, retirement plans as a tax tool, payroll and contractor rules, sales tax across states, and what to do when the IRS writes. Each episode takes one question an owner actually asks and answers it in plain English — what the rule is, who it applies to, and where people trip up. Written for founders, freelancers and owners of small and growing companies who want to understand their taxes well enough to ask their accountant the right questions. General education, not individual tax advice. Five or six minutes, one topic. Topics include entity choice and S-corp elections, owner pay, the QBI deduction, SEP and SIMPLE IRAs and 401(k)s, estimated taxes, payroll tax and 1099s, multi-state and sales tax, year-end planning, bookkeeping for tax time, and IRS notices, penalties and payment plans. Produced by SmallBusinessTaxes.com, tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll and CFO advisory for small businesses. Full details, services and further reading at https://smallbusinesstaxes.com

title: maid.co
author: maid.co
description: Running a cleaning company that actually makes money. Pricing homes and offices so the job still pays after drive time and supplies, quoting commercial contracts, keeping recurring clients, scheduling crews, and the checklists that stop a re-clean before it happens. Each episode takes one decision a cleaning business owner is facing — raise prices or not, hourly or flat rate, when to hire the second cleaner, whether commercial work is worth chasing — and works it through practically, with the arithmetic shown. Written for owners and office managers of residential and commercial cleaning companies, from solo cleaners to multi-crew teams. Five or six minutes, one topic. Topics include pricing and quoting cleans, recurring clients, scheduling and crews, hiring, training and retention, quality control and checklists, move-out and vacation rental work, commercial contracts, invoicing and getting paid, and growing to a second location. Produced by maid.co, the all-in-one software for cleaning companies. Full details, services and further reading at https://maid.co

Spooky.

title: WellTell Story
author: WellTell Story
description:
Real stories. Simple English.
WellTell Story brings you true stories about remarkable people, places, and moments, told in clear, accessible English. Each episode introduces useful vocabulary in context, helping you build your listening skills and remember new words through the story.
Come for the story. Leave with the words.

title: Ash Tales
author: Ryan Law
description: Original short stories about the end of the world. From nuclear war to zombie apocalypse, Ash Tales explores humanity’s timeless obsession with its own demise. Each episode brings you a standalone story from a dark new world. Created by Ryan Law. Read more stories, explore the podcast archive and submit your own fiction at ashtales.com.

title: "Whispers on the Mountain" Audio Book
author: Amanda Lamb
description:
This is the long-awaited audio version of my recently published murder mystery, "Whispers on the Mountain." Chapters will be released one at a time. Listen weekly to help solve the mystery!
When Celia Finch arrives at the Bingham Reserve in the North Carolina mountains, something is very wrong. Celia is supposed to be on a much-needed family vacation, but when she hears whispers about a missing woman in the beautiful but treacherous landscape, she can't ignore the pull of the mystery.
Did Pamela Stevens get lost? Was she lying injured on the trail? Or did something more sinister happen? Soon, Celia is mired in the middle of a potential murder investigation, and everyone has something to hide:
The Type-A Resort Manager
The Devastated Husband
The Rest-on-his-Laurels Deputy
The Grizzled Local Water-Sports Guide
With each passing day, the road to unraveling the mystery grows colder and the odds of finding the lost hiker alive diminish. Despite the risk to her family, her sanity, and her safety, Celia refuses to give up the search. She's been down this dark path of obsession in a case before, and this time she is determined to find the missing woman alive.
Order the book online wherever you get your books!

I'm Jonathan Slaven, and I tell true stories that change how you see things.
In Or So It Seemed, I take a walk and tell you what happened behind the version everyone knows. A business decision that looked right until everything changed. Two inventions connected by a trail nobody expected. An underdog who had one moment on top. The real story behind a famous quote. Or a fact that sounds impossible until you check it.
Some stories take a few turns. Others get right to the point. Either way, there's something worth knowing.
Come walk with me. I've got a new story every Wednesday.

title: One Great Brand Campaign a Day
author: Woon
description:
One day. One campaign. One fresh idea.
Behind every great brand campaign is a decision that challenges the ordinary.
Each episode, we unpack one remarkable campaign: what it achieved, how it broke from industry conventions, and why that difference mattered.
Then we go one step further — exploring what the campaign reveals about brands, consumers, creativity, and the business of marketing.
And also you could use my skills to get your own campaign idea inspiration: https://www.agensi.io/skills/campaign-idea-inspiration

title: Did You Know! Dad
author: Mitchell
description: The “Did You Know?” Dad delivers fast-paced, hilarious deep dives into weird history, accidental inventions, and humanity’s biggest "oops" moments. Packed with peak Dad energy and zero academic jargon, it’s the ultimate trivia show designed to make you the most interesting person in any room.

title: Scary Stories from Beyond
author: CJ P
description:
There are stories we tell to pass the time.

And then there are stories that find us.

One night, a man came across an old transistor radio.


It looked harmless enough, worn at the edges and silent beneath a film of dust.

But when he turned the dial, something answered.

Not music.

Not news.

Voices.

He was the only one who could hear them.Each transmission carried a story from beyond the familiar world: tales of the supernatural, outer worlds, out-of-body journeys, limbo, creatures of every variety, morality plays, and impossible encounters that defy explanation.

Some are horrifying.

Some are strangely enlightening.

All of them come from somewhere we were never meant to see.


Now he shares those transmissions with us.

Because sometimes the strangest stories leave us with the clearest warnings.


This is Scary Stories from Beyond, presented by the Underground Artist Network.

New transmissions drop on the first day of every month at 7 p.m. Central Time.



Sign up for notifications for special broadcasts, too.

They may arrive on a holiday, in the dead of night, or whenever the dial receives a signal from someone beyond who thinks you need to listen.T

he radio is on.

Are you listening?

title: Murder, He Wrote

description:
What does writing a cosy mystery actually look like week to week? (Spoiler: a lot of tea and asking myself if this is all too obvious!)
​Join me, SJ Crooke, for Murder, He Wrote: The Cosy Author’s Diary. Every week, I’m sharing short, honest updates on my progress writing a debut whodunit, the plot snags, the draft breakthroughs, and quick reviews of my favourite recent reads.
​Hit subscribe to follow the mess, the magic, and the journey from blank page to published book!

description:
Evil Uncovered goes into the darkest chapters of the human story, from horrifying crimes to atrocities, disasters and cover-ups that shocked the world.
Each episode takes one disturbing incident and follows it from the beginning. We look at who was involved, what really happened, and the warning signs that were missed. 
If you're drawn to true crime, dark history and the unsettling side of human nature, press follow and step into the dark with us.
Writer Garth Maunders

title: Spokane Daily
author: Jethro Jones
description: Spokane Daily tells the stories of how local people actually make a living. Join Jethro Jones, the Optimization Doc, for conversations with Spokane-area business owners about why they started, how their businesses make money, what's working, and what they're building next. From solo operators and family businesses to growing local companies, each episode goes inside the work: the people, numbers, decisions, and challenges behind the business. Hear practical lessons you can use, discover businesses worth knowing, and meet the people shaping Spokane's business community. When we talk about AI, we focus on what it means for local businesses.

title: TEACH for the Future
author: T.E.A.C.H.
description: TEACH for the Future is a youth-led podcast from the TEACH program (Teens Educating and Confronting Homophobia, Transphobia, Biphobia, Lesbophobia, and Queerphobia) at Planned Parenthood Toronto. We talk about queer and trans identities, histories, relationships, health, and community through an anti-oppressive lens. Each episode brings youth voices and lived experiences into conversations about what it means to build safer, more inclusive futures.

title: Nail Talk with Margo
author: Margarita Yutsaytis
description:
Nails, Education & Competitions is a professional nail industry podcast hosted by Margarita Yutsaytis, an award-winning nail artist, educator, competition judge, and founder of Mars Nails in New York City.


Each episode explores the professional nail industry from the inside - Russian manicure, dry e-file pedicure, nail structure and architecture, advanced techniques, nail education, competition preparation, judging, and industry standards.


Drawing on her experience as an educator, competitor, judge, and salon owner, Margarita shares practical lessons, common mistakes, competition insights, and real-world experiences from the nail industry.


Whether you're a beginner nail technician, an experienced professional, or an educator looking to refine your skills, this podcast offers an inside perspective on the techniques, decisions, and professional standards behind quality nail work.

title: Fact Checked By: Taylor Delong
author: Taylor Delong
description: Fact-Checked is a documentary podcast that dives deep into the stories behind today’s most debated topics. Each episode unpacks complex issues, explores historical context, and separates truth from misinformation with rigorous research and expert insights. From uncovering hidden histories to demystifying trending claims, Fact-Checked ensures listeners walk away informed and empowered. Join us for a journey through facts, myths, and the narratives shaping our world—because every story deserves the truth.

description:
Car Boot Challenge is a fun, light‑hearted show inspired by the great British tradition of car boot sales. Full of stories, bargains and playful competition, it’s a celebration of curiosity, community and shared experiences.

The programme is broadcast on Poppyland Radio, a community station from the heart of North Norfolk. Created by local people, Poppyland Radio reflects local life through music, storytelling and specialist shows inspired by the Poppyland coast and countryside.

title: I Love Palm Beach
author: Rebecca Giacobba
description: The insiders guide to moving and living in Palm Beach County, Florida! Palm Beach has a misconception that it lacks depth, history and character. This is so far from true and this podcast explores the special qualities that Palm Beach County offer. You will hear most residents say their only regret is that they did not move here sooner. As residents from the Northern states are looking for options to save on taxes their number one choice is Florida. Even former President Trump has declared Palm Beach Florida his permanent residence! If you are one of these possible transplants or you just love Palm Beach follow along to learn more about what it is like to live and play in this amazing place. Look for our " in quest" of episodes where we search for the best of: pizza, hoagies, bagels....or you might like our local heroes stories or just want to learn about unique facts in purchasing your Florida home or moving your business...either way we hope you enjoy and learn to fall in love with Palm Beach. www.giaelite.com/ 410-320-4868

title: Discover Calvary
author: Jay Knight
description:
Discover Calvary is a podcast of Calvary Baptist Church devoted to helping people know what we believe, why we believe it, and how biblical truth shapes our life together as a church family.


Whether you are an interested listener who found us through your favorite podcast purveyor, someone new to our Church, considering membership, or have been part of our church family for years, these conversations are designed to bring clarity to the foundational truths of the Christian faith and the convictions that guide our church. We’ll talk about Scripture, the Gospel, church membership, Baptist doctrine, worship, discipleship, Christian living, and what it means to belong faithfully to a local church.


Our aim is not merely to know more, but to know Christ more deeply, to understand His Word more clearly, and to live together more faithfully as His people.


Clear truth. Biblical conviction. Gospel-centered church life.

Rosie and Graham follow the evidence on the road to AGI and beyond — the week's most significant AI developments, what they indicate about where this is heading, and what it means for humanity's future. Each short lesson explains how a part of your business really runs: Processes, client journeys, SOPs, metrics, automation and AI, with worked examples and one exercise to try that week.
Season 1: Build a Business That Works. New lessons every Tuesday.

description:
Chaplain Tim shares Scriptural Based Guidance on God's way of living a fulfilling life for NOW and for Eternity!"
EVERYONE is aware of the good and evil that exists in the world. Would you CHOOSE to live a life of hope and promise? Or would you CHOOSE a life of despair and disappointment?
The right choice in anything, is based on foundational principals of IDENTITY. Who we are. How we live our lives. And where we base our trust and confidence in succeeding.

title: Princeton Flying School Podcast
author: HG Media
description:
Welcome to the Princeton Flying School Podcast, hosted by certified flight instructor Rosalva “Rosie" Soto. This podcast explores the unique journeys of the aviators who make up the Princeton Flying School community, including students, fellow instructors, and others whose lives have brought them to the airfield.
Through candid conversations, Rosie dives into how people find their way into the cockpit, what inspires them to start flying, and how they navigate the inevitable challenges of flight training. Drawing from her own experience transitioning from a flight attendant to a pilot, and overcoming the steep learning curve of mastering landings, Rosie and her guests discuss the hard work, self-doubt, and perseverance required to earn their wings.
Whether you are an active student, a seasoned pilot, or simply someone who looks up at the sky and wonders what it takes to fly, this podcast offers genuine, inspiring stories from the flight deck.   • A Call to Action: Help us digitize these stories! When an episode hits 100+ likes, we turn the featured folktale into a dedicated animated video for educators to use directly in their classrooms.
Join our community of change-makers as we bridge ancient wisdom with modern tools to inspire the next generation. Tune in, share with your staff and families, and help us build a new millennium grounded in old, unbreakable principles.

title: STILL HERE, STILL LAUGHING ... LIVING WITH CLL
author: Richard Hearsey
description: On Monday, the 20th of July 2026, I went for a routine blood test. By ten o'clock that night, the NHS was sending an ambulance to my house. By the early hours of Tuesday morning, I was lying in Yeovil Hospital, hooked up to machines, receiving blood transfusions, and being told I had leukaemia. And the first thing I asked was ... "How long have I got?" Not exactly the Monday I'd been planning. This is the story of how I discovered I had chronic lymphocytic leukaemia, or CLL, and what it's been like trying to get my head around it.

title: ServiceNow Best Practices and Expert Advice
author: Michael Murphy
description:
Get more from the platform you already own.


Most ServiceNow instances do not fail because the platform falls short. They stall because early decisions in design, configuration, data, governance, and adoption quietly compound into technical debt, slow upgrades, and frustrated users.

This book gathers the best practices and expert advice that separate healthy, scalable platforms from fragile ones. It is the guidance I wish I could have handed you before the engagement began.


  • Build on design and governance decisions that hold up at scale
  • Favor configuration over customization and stay upgrade-ready
  • Protect data quality and retire the technical debt that slows teams down
  • Drive adoption so licenses turn into measurable outcomes


What actually works, what quietly fails, and why.

author: Chora Media - Simone Clemente
description:
Gli etruschi hanno dominato e influenzato l’Italia molto prima dell’ascesa di Roma. Parlavano una lingua diversa da tutte quelle conosciute e la loro origine e ancora oggi dibattuta. Hanno conteso il dominio del mediterraneo a greci e fenici, hanno dato a Roma riti e culti. Poi, quando la loro era è finita, sono scomparsi senza lasciare quasi nessuna traccia scritta. Esistono però delle tombe meravigliose con cui ricostruire la loro storia, la loro vita, il mondo dei vivi e quello dei morti. Sono il portale che attraverseremo per raccontarli in questa serie podcast.


Progetto finanziato a valere sui fondi Legge 20 febbraio 2006, n. 77 "Misure speciali di tutela e fruizione dei siti e degli elementi italiani di interesse culturale, paesaggistico e ambientale, inseriti nella "lista del patrimonio mondiale", posti sotto tutela dell'UNESCO".

author: beyondth
description: The Influence Engine is your source for powerful insights into podcast marketing, organic audience growth, digital branding, and online influence. Discover proven strategies, expert advice, and actionable tips to grow your podcast, reach more listeners, improve visibility on Apple Podcasts, and build a strong digital presence. Build your audience. Grow your impact. Turn your voice into influence!

title: The Tech Frontier
author: Market Street Production
description: Welcome to The Tech Frontier, your go-to podcast for exploring the exciting world of technology! Here, we talk about the latest tech trends, amazing innovations, artificial intelligence, smart devices, digital transformation, and everything shaping the future. From everyday technology to groundbreaking discoveries, we make complex topics simple, interesting, and easy to understand. Whether you're a tech enthusiast, a curious learner, or simply someone who wants to keep up with the digital world, this podcast is for you. So, sit back, relax, and join us as we explore new ideas, discover exciting innovations, and take a closer look at how technology is changing our lives. Stay curious, stay connected, and let's explore the future together with The Tech Frontier!

title: How’d you sleep??
author: Hosted by Kai and Ashton
description:
The concept
Every morning starts the same way:
“How’d you sleep?”
But the answer is never just about sleep.
It becomes a jumping-off point for motherhood, relationships, friendships, the mental load, funny stories, things you’re obsessed with, things you’re currently pissed about, and the completely random rabbit holes two life long friends inevitably fall into!

title: Those Were The Days With Des Cahill
author: RTÉ Radio 1
description: As part of RTÉ 100 celebrations, Des Cahill delves into the RTÉ radio sport archives to unearth some hidden broadcasting gems

title: Hey Lovely
author: Robyn Mae
description: Hey Lovely is a lifestyle and wellness podcast focused on self care, habits, mindset and navigating real life at your own pace. Think cozy chats, gentle motivation and big sister advice for becoming your healthiest, calmest self.

title: The Bold Move
author: Alex and Sam
description: Every great company starts with one bold move. Alex and Sam dive into the real stories behind the founders, deals and gambles that changed business, from a telecom that gave free data to a whole country to the side hustle that became a brand. Sharp storytelling, friendly debates and big economic news decoded in 10 to 15 minutes. No lectures, no jargon: just the moves, the mistakes and the ideas you can steal for your own project. New episode every one to two days.

title: THE 3AM PROTOCOL
author: The 3AM Protocol
description:
Some stories should only be heard after midnight. Every episode comes from our YouTube channel, where you can watch them in full, plus members-only stories that never go public: https://www.youtube.com/@The3AMProtocol
THE 3AM PROTOCOL is horror narration for the late hours: Ouija boards, possessions, Japanese ghost stories, abandoned places and night shifts that go wrong. Long episodes made for the dark. Turn off the lights, press play, and stay with us until you fall asleep.
Has something happened to you that you still can't explain? Write to 3amprotocol@gmail.com.

title: Behind the Byline with OutKick
author: Outkick
description: The stories you won’t read in the PR press releases. On "Behind the Byline with OutKick", our top investigative reporters, columnists, and writers step out from behind the keyboard to sit down with the biggest names across sports, Hollywood, and modern culture. From marquee athletes and iconic broadcasters to cultural rebels, viral disruptors, and headline-makers, we ask the questions mainstream media is too afraid to touch. No talking points, no media training, no corporate filters—just raw, unapologetic conversations about the games, the controversies, and the culture defining our world.

title: Not At The Party with Brock Valesini
author: Tiny Guy Media
description: Hosted by Brock Valesini: unserious, charming, religiously online, and notoriously Not At The Party (by choice, obviously). For him, being obsessed with internet culture, fandoms, and celebrities has never just been an interest. It's how he’s made sense of his entire life. He’s 21 and dealing with societal expectations, career panic, and hyper-fixations. Every Tuesday, Brock’s peeling off the red carpet outfits and popping on some cozy merch, ready to dive into what he loves and how he feels. This one’s for the bricks (that’s you xx).

Discover the latest KFC menu items, delicious burgers, crispy fried chicken, sides, desserts, and family meals. Explore updated prices, meal deals, and special offers to help you choose your favourite KFC meals.

description:
The epic tale of Kal Centari: a human, a soldier, and a newly freed slave. 
His story takes place, in a time and space, where super inteligent machine brains have solved most of the real obstacles to space travel. "The only real danger now is the people."

Through biblical preaching and sound doctrine, our desire is to encourage, challenge, and equip you to stand firmly on The Truth and live out your faith each day.

title: Data Science Course In Delhi
author: sakshitechex
description:
The Data Science Course at Tech Explica is designed to help students and professionals develop practical skills in data analysis, statistical modelling, and machine learning. The course covers essential tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Pandas, and NumPy. Learners gain knowledge of data collection, data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, predictive modelling, and data visualisation through practical assignments and real-world projects. The programme also provides industry-oriented training, project experience, and career guidance to help learners prepare for opportunities in the growing field of data science.

Explore the course:

title: l'Intelligence, Et après?
author: Carole Harari
description: L'intelligence, c'est quoi ? C'est autour de cette question que s'articule cette série podcast. Tout le monde a sa petite idée sur la question, même s'il n'en existe pas de définition. En quatre épisodes, on démonte tous les clichés sur ce concept, à commencer par l'idée de surdouance – le fameux haut potentiel intellectuel. Puis, on va la chercher partout où elle se trouve, loin du cerveau humain : dans la nature, mais aussi en nous et entre nous.

title: Wordle Hint Today – Daily Hints, Tips &
author: Wordle Hint Today
description:
Wordle Hint Today (WHT) is an independent platform for word puzzle lovers who enjoy solving daily Wordle challenges. We share helpful hints, practical strategies, word-solving tips, and insights to improve vocabulary, sharpen thinking skills, and make every puzzle more enjoyable.Whether you're a beginner or an experienced Wordle player, our goal is to help you solve puzzles with confidence while keeping the fun of discovering answers yourself.Visit Our Website:

title: The Proof
author: rdrghvk@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Proof tells the true stories behind the greatest ideas in mathematics. Each episode, host Nirob takes one number, one problem, or one proof — the forbidden zero, the ratio pi that never ends, the secret in the margin that took 350 years to solve, the bridges that founded a new science, the unsolved riddle worth a million dollars — and rebuilds it: the mathematicians who chased it, the struggle to solve it, the moment of breakthrough, and the world it made.

From Euclid's geometry to the calculus wars of Newton and Leibniz, from Hypatia of Alexandria to Andrew Wiles's seven-year secret, from the first proof done by a computer to the mathematics of infinity, The Proof is about the quiet, thrilling power of mathematics — how it is discovered, how it is proved, and why a handful of symbols can unlock the universe. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

title: Flight Path: How healthcare leaders got their start - and who's coming next
author: Jordan Mitchell
description: A podcast from the University of Houston-Clear Lake on healthcare administration, hosted by Professor Jordan P. Mitchell.

title: Idealistic World: Philosophical Works & Deep Critique
author: Nima Shahsavari
description: An uncompromising philosophical exploration rooted in Janism, the critique of structural power, and the sanctity of all sentient life. Authored by Nima Shahsavari, this series serves as the official audio archive of the Idealistic World. In each dedicated episode, a new foundational book, essay, or poetic manuscript is deeply examined, revealing the architecture of existence beyond anthropocentrism. As an ongoing, expanding serial journey covering over fifty core works and future writings, this podcast maps the return to the authentic foundations of life.

title: Thinking Capital
author: Bloomberg Media Studios
description:
In a world with more information, opportunity and ways to build prosperity than ever before, where should we focus our attention?
Through fresh perspectives on cultural fluency, intellectual curiosity, social networks and financial growth, discover an expanding definition of capital — and what it takes to build it.

title: Planning a Smooth Relocation with House
author: Team Removals Austraila
description: A successful house move starts with a clear plan. This podcast shares practical advice for anyone preparing to relocate in Adelaide. Discover how House Removals Adelaide professionals help with furniture handling, safe transportation, packing and unloading. We also discuss useful ways to organise boxes, sort household items and avoid common moving-day problems. If you're preparing for a local move, these simple tips can help keep everything on track and make the transition to your new property much easier.

title: Johnny to a Million
author: Johnny Goedde
description:
I'm Johnny. Small-town hustler, real estate dabbler, AI experimenter, and bartender. I'm starting from debt, divorce, heartbreak, diagnosed with ADD, and a Goal. This channel is where I document every step of the way to a million.
What's a "million"? Maybe it's a million in net worth, a million in controlled assets, a million in yearly income, or even a million people reached. I don't know which one will hit first-- but I'm sharing the wins, the losses, and the lessons until I get there. 
If you ever felt broke, stuck, or like you are one move away from breaking through, this is for you.

Narrative episodes and conversations, made in Nairobi.

Cybersecurity is constantly evolving, but are organisations keeping up?
Welcome to DataDefenz Cyber Talks, where we explore real-world cyber incidents, emerging threats, AI, security governance, risk management, and the human side of cybersecurity.

Real threats. Real conversations. Practical cybersecurity insights.

title: Historia - A History Podcast by Michaela Pangowish
author: Michaela Pangowish
description: Historia is a podcast exploring all corners of the world. It is first and foremost a history podcast, but it's also a podcast about people and how we exist in this world. Michaela Pangowish explores the world through its past and the things we say about the past. From Ancient Greece to Modern North America, Historia travels through history for the joy of knowing. Remember, history is made in conversation.

title: Jim Ryan Fitness Podcast
author: Jim Ryan
description:
Eat well all week, then lose it at the weekend? Start again every Monday? You’re not lacking willpower. You’re stuck in a cycle, and this podcast is about breaking it.
I’m Jim Ryan, a former primary school teacher turned personal trainer, nutritionist and online coach based in Dublin. I used to teach kids about good and bad foods. Now I help adults unlearn that, lose fat without the extremes, and build habits that actually last.
Every week you’ll get practical, no-nonsense episodes on fat loss, emotional eating, night-time snacking, honest conversations with experts and a bit of a laugh!

title: Villa Villani
author: Max
description:
Villa Villani — Come On In... and Wait to Be Seated!
Welcome to Villa Villani, where the food is magnificent, the wine flows freely, and getting a table might require divine intervention! Join Don Angelo and his gloriously eccentric Italian family at their famous Mount Martha restaurant, where customers rarely get what they order, nobody escapes dessert, and even the Pope may have to queue. Adapted from the humorous novella by Australian author Max Barrington, this delightful podcast serial serves up laughter, family chaos and Italian hospitality. Buon appetito!

title: Late Night Prairie Radio
author: Late Night Prairie Radio
description:
Late Night Prairie Radio is a little station somewhere on the Prairies, bringing you intriguing stories — from extraordinary lives and fascinating history to mysteries, oddities, and the unexpected. You never quite know what’s coming over the air.
Late Night Prairie Radio.
A little station. A world of stories.

title: The Jewish Singer
author: Nechama Leah Dahan
description: This podcast is for Jewish singers on a journey to become not only a good singer, but a well-rounded vocal artist with meaningful music to inspire and light up the world. Here we'll explore how to bridge the gap between technique and artistry with discussions about artist identity, vocal technique, stepping into the Jewish music scene with confidence, developing healthy singer mindsets, practice routines, and so much more.

title: After October 7: A Quillette Podcast
author: Pamela Paresky
description: Psychologist and Quillette contributor Pamela Paresky travelled across Israel in the wake of October 7 and interviewed Israeli intellectuals, politicians, servicemen, and others about Hamas’s attack on Israel, how it happened and how it’s changed the country and the world.

title: The when fallacy: Why we never start.
author: Joshua Rosa
description: A podcast about stopping the lies of ”when” to start living now.

title: Amy Good
author: Amy Good
description:
A quiet audio series for the end of a day.
Each episode is a slow walk through a house at night, described rather than instructed. A kitchen closed rather than cleaned. A lamp left on. A door checked once.
No guidance, no breathing exercises, nothing to complete. Just somewhere calm to fall asleep inside, from the person behind the Good by Amy slow living films.
New episodes weekly. Best listened to in the dark, at the point in the evening when the day is finished whether or not it is done.

title: The Audit Window
author: Safeguard
description: A weekly compliance podcast for security, GRC and startup teams: SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, vendor risk management (TPRM), audit evidence, compliance automation, security questionnaires and audit readiness. Each episode covers recent compliance news, one control walked through step by step, and a checklist for your audit window. Topics: observation window, auditor, risk assessment, trust center. Learn more at safeguard.sh.

description:
A collection of unsolicited thoughts, questionable observations, and adventures nobody asked me to document.
Occasionally insightful. Frequently distracted. Almost never on topic.

title: Éist: Grief, Shame and Finding Your Way Back to Yourself
author: Éilís Ní Chriocháin
description:
Have you ever sat with someone who hardly said a word, and still came away feeling completely understood?
Éist is the Irish for listen. Each week, Éilís Ní Chriocháin tells one story and ends with a tune. The stories begin in a small sitting room in the west of Ireland, where her teacher, Eddie Kelly, taught her the fiddle. They carry on through grief, shame, and remembering who you really are.
No tips. No advice. Just stories, and the tunes.
Éilís’s music is on Spotify and Apple Music as Éilís Crean.

title: Memmory & History Podcast
author: KEYS EDUCATION PODCAST
description: Welcome to Memmory & History Podcast, where the past comes alive through fascinating stories, unforgettable events, and remarkable moments that shaped our world. From ancient civilizations and historical mysteries to famous figures, legendary battles, and forgotten stories, we explore history in a simple and enjoyable way. Each episode takes you on a journey through time, uncovering interesting facts and stories that you may have never heard before. So, sit back, relax, and join us as we discover the past, understand the present, and explore the stories that continue to shape our future. Because history is more than just dates and events — it's a collection of stories worth remembering.

title: Telemaco
author: Chora Media - Francesca Berardi
description:
Finiti gli studi, un tempo si avevano davanti dei binari: pochi percorsi, chiari e prevedibili. Oggi al loro posto ci sono scie sulla sabbia, possibilità poco definite tra cui è facile perdersi. Questopodcast promosso da Talenti in corso e sostenuto da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo, racconta le storie di giovani donne e uomini che, navigando nel mondo del lavoro, hanno trovatocoordinate utili nel dialogo con coach e mentori. Real stories. Honest conversations. Healing through lived experience.
The Auburn Conversations explores the real experiences behind The Auburn Guide - from mental health, depression and childhood trauma to healing, spiritual awakening, intuition and the experiences we don't always know how to explain. Through honest conversations and lived experience, SJ Williams creates space for the stories that shape us, challenge us and sometimes change what we believe is possible.

title: Need to Move One Furniture Item? Choose

description: Transporting a single heavy item can be challenging without the right equipment and experience. Professional movers help make single item moving simple, affordable and convenient. If you are located in Aldinga Beach, choosing a reliable local moving service can save time and reduce the risk of damage. Make your next small move easier with experienced furniture removalists.

title: From the Journal
author: Soul Artist Journal
description:
From the pages of Soul Artist Journal come the voices of artists, visionaries, healers, teachers, makers and extraordinary people who bring creative freedom to life.

Through intimate conversations, we explore the stories behind their work—the inspirations, influences, unexpected turns and lived experiences that shape their art and illuminate what it means to be human.

This is an invitation into the many ways we create, connect, and make meaning in the world.

title: Closet Monster Stories, Horror From The Darkness Within
author: Darren Felbel
description: Blood curdling stories from the creator of Grampa's Tales of Terror!

title: The Learning Curve@ESU
author: Dr. Nahla Abousamra
description:
The Learning Curve@ESU is a podcast dedicated to exploring the ideas, challenges, and opportunities shaping education today. Hosted through East Stroudsburg University’s Department of Early Childhood, the podcast brings together educators, students, faculty, and education professionals to discuss meaningful issues in teaching and learning.

From early childhood education and student success to innovative teaching approaches, educational technology, and current challenges in schools and communities, each episode offers practical insights and thoughtful conversations. Our goal is to highlight what works, address the challenges educators and students face, and explore new ways to create engaging, inclusive, and supportive learning environments.

The Learning Curve@ESU—where we explore education, support learners, and grow together, one conversation at a time.

title: Tales from the Bucket
author: Creators Co.
description:
Tales from the Bucket is a horror anthology podcast hosted by Cemetery Joe, the wretched radio man behind a late-night broadcast devoted to the bizarre, the unexplained, and the supernatural.

Each episode is a horror audio drama in which the people who lived through the nightmare tell their own story, in their own words. Adapted from viral r/nosleep stories by writer and director Cory De Silva, the series brings you ghosts, vengeful spirits, nefarious creatures, and small-town legends, with atmospheric sound design and an original theme by Hannah Mae Green. If you like creepypasta, first-person horror, and spooky audio fiction, this is the show for you.

Starring John Welsh as Cemetery Joe. Written and directed by Cory De Silva. Recorded and edited by T.L. Green. A Creators Co. production from Redding, California.

Listen on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, or watch every episode on YouTube at Creators Co. TV. Best heard with headphones, in the dark, after midnight.

Subscribe, rate, and review to help Cemetery Joe reach more listeners. After all, it's important that everyone knows monsters do exist.

title: Truck and SUV Buying Notes

description: Reality Unpacked is your new favorite hot topics series, hosted by tv personality and drag artist Mo Heart and Emmy-nominated creative producer AJ Rowe. We're serving unfiltered reactions, while keeping it ALL THE WAY real about today in reality!

title: My Cousin Across the Street
author: mycousinpod
description: Ever wonder how two Mexican girls survived the era of The Price is Right, VapoRub, 7-Up, and enough generational trauma to fund a therapist's retirement? Welcome to My Cousin Across the Street. We’re Mia and Liz, and because you're listening, congratulations—you’re our cousin now too. We’re trading the rotary phones for microphones to dissect the chaos of our childhoods and the absolute audacity of being women in our 40s. From our current mental health struggles to the nostalgic goldmines of our youth, we dive deep into who we became while trying not to lose our minds along the way. Expect unfiltered sarcasm, actual deep dives, and zero sugar-coating. Grab an iced coffee (or something stronger) and join the family meeting. An Espresso Martini will check off 2 boxes, just sayin'. We're your cousins now! Hi cousin!

Welcome to Let's Talk with Veenaa and Kishen, an additional series from Zen & Now.

A space for honest conversations, different perspectives and the topics that make us think a little deeper.

Veenaa and Kishen come together to explore life, relationships, mental health, personal growth, everyday experiences and everything in between.

Expect candid discussions, relatable moments, a little humour, plenty of reflection and conversations that don't always have straightforward answers.

No scripts, no pressure and no rush. Just real people talking about real life.

Let's Talk. Real conversations, no rush.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Pursuit of Wonder
author: Pursuit of Wonder
description:
Fostering reflection through powerful ideas and stories.

Wonder is the feeling of curiosity and appreciation inspired by something beautiful, inexplicable, or unfamiliar. At Pursuit of Wonder, we create work with the aim of producing that feeling.

Through video essays, short stories, guided experiences, books, and more, we explore a wide range of topics related to philosophy, psychology, science, literature, well-being, and more. In A Table Prepared, actor, activist, and author Ashley Judd and Dan Scott — affectionately known as Brother Dan — invite listeners into the honest spiritual conversations, laughter, and Appalachian music they've shared for more than 40 years.

Rooted in their shared Appalachian heritage and mountain faith traditions, their conversations are Christian and ecumenical in spirit, welcoming listeners of different faiths, convictions, and questions. Dan, an ordained Anglican priest, author and spiritual director, brings decades of ministry and spiritual leadership to conversations shaped equally by personal experience.

Together, Ashley and Brother Dan explore forgiveness, compassion, family, boundaries, accountability, and what it means to live out one's faith when deeply held beliefs are challenged.

Theirs is a faith spacious enough for both/and: grief and gratitude, anger and tenderness, hope and an unflinching awareness of suffering.

Through personal stories, scripture, and music, they make room for difficult questions, honest disagreement, and the possibility of being changed by one another.

Laugh, sing, feel, think, reflect, and pray with us.

Early on Wednesday.
That’s when the stories nobody wants to tell start to unravel. When the headlines have gone quiet, but the evidence still screams.
Every week, two investigative journalists dig past the official reports and tear into the cases that never found closure. Unsolved murders, vanishing cults, the fractured psychology behind true crime—if there’s a file stamped “inconclusive,” we’re the ones prying it open.
But we don’t stop at crime scenes and courtrooms. We follow the trail into conspiracies, cryptids, and the paranormal—anywhere the facts twist into something darker. We gather what’s buried, piece together what’s missing, and hold up the uncomfortable truths that most would rather leave in the dark.
On Early on Wednesday, you’ll find the psychological patterns behind the horror, the hidden details history tried to erase, and the connections that make your skin crawl.
Because every mystery leaves a paper trail. And we intend to follow it—wherever it leads.

The Nature of Being is not a show about beliefs, techniques, or spiritual identities. It’s an invitation into the living immediacy of experience — the place where awareness, perception, and existence are already one.
Hosted by spoken‑word artist and contemplative teacher Mark Stidham, each episode cuts through abstraction and points directly to what’s here before thought: the raw presence of Being itself. No gurus. No systems. No inherited language. Just a clear, grounded, experiential look at the nature of reality and the illusion of separation.
Through poetic inquiry, etymological play, and direct contemplative guidance, Mark explores themes like awareness, identity, consciousness, and the simplicity of “what is.” The aim isn’t to teach you something new — it’s to illuminate what has never been absent.
If you’re drawn to the intersection of clarity, intensity, and lived recognition, this podcast is a companion for the pathless path.

title: Reasonable Deconstruction with Unoriginal Jim
author: Unoriginal Jim
description:
Reasonable Deconstruction is a thoughtful examination of Mormonism, its history, scriptures, doctrines, and the ways those teachings affect real people. Drawing from my own experience of growing up within the faith, defending its truth claims, and eventually learning to question them, I explore difficult subjects through history, evidence, context, and personal experience. My goal is not to be contentious, snarky, or dismissive, and it certainly isn’t to make fun of people who believe differently. Instead, I want to ask honest questions, examine what the sources actually say, separate evidence from apologetics and interpretation, and consider how these teachings have shaped my life and the lives of others. 
For me, deconstruction isn’t about tearing something down simply because I no longer believe it. It’s about taking it apart carefully enough to understand how it was built, what is supported by evidence, what isn’t, and what happens when we give ourselves permission to follow the evidence wherever it leads.
